title: WHO: in 2022, 59 percent of adults with diabetes aged 30 and over were not on medication
summary: The diabetes fact sheet says more than half of people with diabetes were not taking medication in 2022, and gives 59 percent for adults aged 30 and over.
body: WHO's diabetes fact sheet says that in 2022 more than half of people living with diabetes did not take medication for their diabetes, and, more specifically, that 59 percent of adults aged 30 years and over who were living with diabetes were not taking medication. It says treatment coverage was lowest in low- and middle-income countries. The 59 percent is the sheet's 2022 figure for that age group.
